stable.linux: NEURON_WHEEL_DIR=$(mktemp -d) && pip3 download --no-deps --dest "$NEURON_WHEEL_DIR" "torch-neuronx==2.14.*" "neuronx-cc==2.*" "nki>=0.6" --index-url https://pip.repos.neuron.amazonaws.com && pip3 install "torch==2.14.0" --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && pip3 install "$NEURON_WHEEL_DIR"/*.whl && rm -r "$NEURON_WHEEL_DIR"
